name: Chicken Biryani (Single Plate)
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice cooked with tender marinated chicken, traditional Lahori spices, steamed potato (aloo), and served with chilled mint zeera raita.

name: Special Chicken Pulao
description: Fragrant yakhni basmati rice simmered in slow-cooked chicken broth, flavoured with whole spices, black cumin, and accompanied by a fried shami kebab.

name: Daal Chawal Platter
description: Comforting yellow moong-masoor daal with aromatic desi ghee tarka, served over steamed basmati rice with fresh kachumber salad and spicy mixed achaar.

name: Boneless Chicken Karahi (Single)
description: Succulent boneless chicken wok-cooked in a vibrant tomato, ginger, garlic, and fresh green chilli gravy, served hot with two freshly baked tandoori rotis.

name: Crispy Zinger Burger
description: Golden extra-crispy spicy chicken breast fillet topped with crunchy iceberg lettuce, signature canteen garlic-mayo sauce, and melted cheese in a toasted bun.

name: Chicken Paratha Roll
description: Charcoal-grilled juicy chicken boti tossed with sliced red onions and tangy imli-pudina chutney, tightly wrapped in a crispy flaky fried lachha paratha.

name: Chicken Shawarma Roll
description: Spiced shredded chicken carved fresh from the rotisserie, folded in warm pita bread with crunchy pickled cucumbers, crispy fries, and thick garlic toum sauce.

name: Special Daal Shami Bun Kebab
description: The quintessential street classic: Pan-fried spiced chana daal & beef shami patty, dipped in beaten egg froth, toasted bun, mint raita, and shredded cabbage.

name: Crispy French Fries (Masala)
description: Fresh golden-fried potato sticks dusted generously with signature Lahori chaat masala, served with garlic mayonnaise and tomato chili sauce.

name: Aloo Samosa (2 Pieces)
description: Pair of jumbo golden crispy pastry pyramids stuffed with spiced cumin-potato filling, fresh coriander, and green chillies. Served with sweet tamarind dip.

name: Mixed Pakora Plate
description: Crunchy besan fritters with sliced potatoes, onions, spinach, and whole coriander seeds, fried fresh to order and served with zesty mint chutney.

name: Lahori Chana Chaat
description: Wholesome boiled chickpeas mixed with boiled potatoes, diced onions, tomatoes, green chillies, crispy papdi crisps, and tangy imli water.

name: Aloo Cheese Paratha
description: Fresh whole wheat flatbread generously stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes and melted cheese, fried golden on the tawa with pure butter.

name: Anda Paratha with Omelette
description: Crispy layered tawa paratha served with a Pakistani street-style 2-egg desi omelette packed with onions, tomatoes, green chillies, and freshly ground black pepper.

name: Karak Doodh Patti Chai
description: Slow-brewed authentic Pakistani canteen tea cooked with rich whole milk, premium black tea leaves, and aromatic crushed green cardamom. Essential for study sessions!

name: Elaichi Green Tea (Kahwa)
description: Light and refreshing Peshawari kahwa infused with cardamom pods and a squeeze of fresh lemon, served with traditional candy sugar crystals.

name: Chilled Rooh Afza Sharbat
description: Pakistan's beloved summer cooler made with chilled rose syrup, ice water, fresh lemon juice, and soaked tukh malanga (basil seeds).

name: Fresh Lime Soda
description: Freshly squeezed tart desi lemons with fizzy club soda, crushed mint, rock salt (kala namak), and sugar syrup served over iced rocks.

name: Hot Gulab Jamun (2 Pieces)
description: Two soft, warm milk khoya dumplings drenched in sweet cardamom and rose scented sugar syrup, garnished with crushed silvered pistachios.

name: Zafrani Matka Kheer
description: Slow-cooked creamy traditional rice pudding made with full fat buffalo milk, saffron strands, cardamom, and almond flakes, served in a clay pot.

name: Chilled Coca-Cola (345ml Bottle)
description: Ice-cold refreshing Coca-Cola glass bottle, frosty cold from the canteen cooler. The classic companion with hot Chicken Biryani or a spicy Zinger Burger.

name: Chilled Pepsi (345ml Bottle)
description: Chilled fizzy Pepsi served frosty cold straight from the campus canteen chiller, perfect with spicy chicken paratha rolls and shawarma.

name: Chilled Fanta (345ml Bottle)
description: Energizing, citrus-flavoured ice-cold Fanta to keep university students charged up through exams and lectures.

name: Special Cardamom Tea (Elaichi Doodh Patti)
description: Rich, fragrant Pakistani canteen tea infused with freshly cracked green cardamom pods and thick buffalo milk, brewed slow on the tawa.

name: Fresh Chaunsa Mango Juice (Chilled)
description: Thick, sweet Pakistani Chaunsa mango pulp blended fresh with crushed ice and a splash of milk. High in vitamin C and authentic Lahore summer flavor.

name: Fresh Multi-Fruit Cocktail Juice
description: Healthy energizing blend of fresh Pakistani seasonal fruits — apple, orange, banana, pomegranate, and pineapple — served chilled with a dash of kala namak.
